chrome-devtools.description: ADR-0038 (Issues #174, #224). A browser for product-lead's read-only sweep, bounded by origin. Since #224 it always attaches to the owner's own running Chrome (--autoConnect, the stable channel's default profile), so it drives a browser holding his logins and Chrome asks him to allow the connection, in any project whose agent calls it; with no declared origin, or one whose host is not plain letters, digits, dots and hyphens with an optional :port, it is bound to the discard port and reaches nothing useful. The shell reads HARNESS_SWEEP_ORIGIN when the server starts, from the environment the harness gives it, which carries the project's settings env. With no value, or one that does not begin http:// or https://, the origin is the discard port, so the browser reaches nothing. The package is pinned to one exact version and fetched with install scripts off.
args: o=$HARNESS_SWEEP_ORIGIN; case "$o" in http://*|https://*) ;; *) o='http://127.0.0.1:9/*' ;; esac; [ "$(printf '%s' "$o" | tr -d '\000-\037\177')" = "$o" ] || o='http://127.0.0.1:9/*'; h=$(printf '%s' "$o" | cut -d/ -f3); case "$h" in ''|*[!abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789.:-]*|:*|*:|*:*[!0123456789]*) o='http://127.0.0.1:9/*' ;; esac; exec npx --ignore-scripts -y chrome-devtools-mcp@1.8.0 --autoConnect --channel stable --no-usage-statistics --no-performance-crux --allowedUrlPattern "$o"
